title: Playwright proves Play while waiting starts speech
description:
## Behavior

Vitest covers Play-while-waiting. CI Playwright must too: click Play before `audio.src` exists, then the clip must start when the job is done.

```gherkin
Feature: Player playback
  Scenario: Play while waiting starts when audio is ready
    Given the player is waiting for audio
    When the listener activates Play
    And the clip becomes ready
    Then playback starts
```

## Implementation brief

1. `site/tests/acceptance.spec.ts` — hold GET `/jobs/:hash` until Play is clicked on `/examples/basic`, then continue and assert Pause + playing audio.
2. Align `example_pages_steps.py` placeholder fixture with clickable Play (no `disabled`).
3. Do not enable PyPI.
